reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding — the issue is the absence of rate limiting, not a dead callee). Gate 2 passed — no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is unauthenticated external HTTP (UNTRUSTED). Gate 3 passed — src/index.ts is explicitly in-scope and 'Discord API rate limiting not implemented' is listed as a key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the unauthenticated GET /health endpoint by flooding it with concurrent requests from any IP, causing each request to invoke client.guilds.fetch() and exhaust the bot's Discord API rate limit quota, disabling all subsequent Discord operations (role sync, role assignment) with 429 errors.
